target_audience: Developers, Security Engineers, DevOps Teams, and IoT/Firmware Developers

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white

sections: Hero with live Security Debt Score gauge preview & instant demo button
Vulnerability Coverage Matrix (OWASP Top 10 + IoT/Firmware rules)
Feature Grid (Deterministic Rules + AI-Assisted Deep Analysis)

components: Language Selector dropdown (Auto-detect, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C/C++, Arduino/ESP32, SQL)
Preset Vulnerable Code snippets buttons (Hardcoded Secrets, SQLi, Buffer Overflow, Unencrypted MQTT/WiFi, Command Injection)
Multi-line Code Editor with line numbers and file upload drag-and-drop zone
Action Bar: 'Scan Code' CTA button with electric neon pulse effect, 'Clear Code' button
Scan Progress modal/indicator showing deterministic static analysis + AI agent evaluation status
Security Debt Score Circular Gauge (0-100 score, dynamic color green to red)
Risk Rating Banner (CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW)
Issue Metric Cards (Critical, High, Medium, Low severity counters)
Debt Breakdown Chart (Severity impact, OWASP category distribution, Exploitability index)
Findings Overview Table with direct line jump links
Selected Finding Details Banner (Vulnerability Name, CWE, OWASP Category, Line Number)
Vulnerable Code Inspector with highlighted threat lines
AI Explanation Panel clearly labeled [AI-Assisted Finding / Mock AI Mode]
Remediation & Secure Code Replacement View (Diff mode / Copyable fix snippet)
Search & Language filter controls
History List Table (Scan ID, Timestamp, Language, Score, Risk Level, Issues count, Actions)
Quick Re-run and View Printable Report actions
Printable/Exportable layout (@media print optimized)
Executive Summary Header with Timestamp, Code Fingerprint, and Risk Badge
Detailed Debt Breakdown Table & Remediation Checklist

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark mode is default using #090D16 background with cyan #00F0FF accents and amber/crimson risk badges.
Implement combined deterministic analysis + AI-assisted analysis service in Python FastAPI.
Support Python, JS/TS, SQL, C/C++, and Arduino/ESP32 IoT firmware security rules.
Include transparent score calculation logic (0-100 debt score based on severity weights, vulnerability count, sensitive data exposure).
Always display '[AI-Assisted Finding]' or '[Mock AI Mode]' badges on AI-generated panels.
Include exportable/printable Security Report formatted for browser printing (@media print styling).
Ensure all interactive components contain data-testid attributes according to testing specs.
